notes: These are original metadata and raw CPG/DDG/solver captures. Native output never used as oracle.

C bare undefined parameter name is its token, type ANY; known typedef/primitive abstract parameters remain unnamed. C++ undefined type abstract parameters remain unnamed with raw type spelling and ANY in canonical method fullname.
C _Bool parameter and parameter identifier types remain _Bool; real primitive return types render bool.

Primitive real return types preserve const/volatile qualifiers and pointer qualifiers; source declarations clean reserved keywords. Named alias/type return metadata uses a separate frontend branch and can discard pointer/ref.
Distinct parameter type spelling, return display spelling and canonical C++ binding types are intentionally retained.
ddg_view nodes/edges are derived only from original DOT IDs and labels.
